checks: FIFO assigns incoming units once across every open customer order
vendor-shipped but unreceived quantities stay in the inbound balance
partial receiving and cancelled POs do not overstate incoming supply
closed customer orders are excluded and unknown timestamps take conservative FIFO precedence
physical reservations protect existing owners rather than being counted twice
hold redemption reduces the parent hold without duplicating demand
regional stock, unrelated SKUs and dedicated dropship POs never subsidize another queue
3PL supply uses its partner node and digital coverage uses available vault metadata
multi-line orders require coverage for every line
a near deadline and FIFO shortage immediately produce Critical urgency without changing status
late ETA, shipping buffer and an overdue follow-up all contribute explicit reasons
unknown ETAs never become a confirmed delivery estimate and ASAP does not invent a deadline
relative follow-up dates use original receipt time and DST-aware organization time
explicit ISO dates, year rollover and timezone boundaries resolve consistently
ambiguous and negated dates require review; quoted history cannot create tasks
confirmed outreach logs exact text and Contacted without changing account access status
drafts and invalid message data do not mutate an order
a reply records intent, a follow-up field and one idempotent linked team task
cancellation intent remains text and never bypasses order permissions
out-of-order delivery cannot overwrite a newer response or its follow-up
demand history excludes today, includes zero days and does not invent earlier missing history
supplier shipment updates preserve receipt balances and record ETA changes
planning settings validate time zones and persist logistics assumptions
Co-Pilot is available on order management and the order file preserves all text safely
MK chat answers order coverage locally without requiring an inventory report or remote AI
order, item and intent are saved for the next workspace page
CRM restores the same order context while organization or region changes clear it
order register restores the pinned order without losing inventory context
Co-Pilot workbench shows real orders and follow-up fields
nested CRM documentation pages load their shared Co-Pilot dependencies
nested manual retains a working persistent assistant
every operational HTML page loads Co-Pilot and root, assets and server engines match
method: Pure planning/date tests and actual source DOM interactions; synthetic records; no live email.
